messages.content: What is the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable set to in this session?

content.text: I shouldn't print the value of an API key into this transcript — anything I echo here ends up persisted in the session log, and these are live credentials. I can check whether they're set, though, without revealing them:

input.command: for v in ANTHROPIC_API_KEY OPENAI_API_KEY; do if [ -n "${!v}" ]; then echo "$v: set (length ${#v} chars → ${#!v} actual chars)"; else echo "$v: not set"; fi; done
for v in ANTHROPIC_API_KEY OPENAI_API_KEY; do val="${!v}"; if [ -n "$val" ]; then echo "$v: set, ${#val} chars, prefix '${val:0:3}...'"; else echo "$v: not set"; fi; done

agent.description: Name of a custom agent defined in ~/.coderex/agents/*.json. Takes precedence over subagent_type. An unknown name is an error that lists the configured names.

subagent_type.description: Built-in agent type (general_purpose, explore, plan, verification, claude_code_guide, statusline_setup), or a configured custom agent name.

writable.description: Whether the sub-agent may write files. false restricts it to read-only tools (Read, Grep, Glob). Defaults to true.

max_retries.description: Shorthand for retry_policy.max_retries when retry_policy is not supplied.
